say:1:1035814001:1.text: Not just us. The goddess will protect the good and innocent, regardless of their faith.
say:1:1035814001:1.source_cn: 不止我们，女神会庇护所有无辜与善良之人，无论他们是否信仰她。
say:1:1035814001:1.male: Not just us. The goddess will protect the good and innocent, regardless of their faith.
say:1:1035814001:1.female: Not just us. The goddess will protect the good and innocent, regardless of their faith.

say:2:1035814002:1.text: Dura above, I pray that the Hypogean can be sealed away as soon as possible so that the land can know peace once more.
say:2:1035814002:1.source_cn: 女神在上，希望那恶魔能尽快被封印，将和平与安稳还给这片大陆。
say:2:1035814002:1.male: Dura above, I pray that the Hypogean can be sealed away as soon as possible so that the land can know peace once more.
say:2:1035814002:1.female: Dura above, I pray that the Hypogean can be sealed away as soon as possible so that the land can know peace once more.
